# Numbered List

`content/numbered-list` &middot; content-level &middot; category: content

## Purpose

A numbered list: plain numbers, numbers in circles, or zero-padded numbers.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | listItems |  |

## Optional fields

None.

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: Plain 1. 2. 3. numbering.
- **circles**: Numbers in filled circles. Sets `numbering: circle`.
- **zero**: Zero-padded numbers (01, 02, 03) in the accent color. Sets `numbering: zero`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `numbering` | one of `decimal`, `circle`, `zero` | `"decimal"` |
| `level` | one of `body`, `bodyLarge`, `bodySmall` | `"body"` |
| `align` | alignment | `"left"` |
| `markerColor` | color | `"@colors.accent"` |
| `markerText` | color | `"@colors.white"` |
| `itemGap` | length | `"@spacing.sm"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"0 0 @spacing.md 0"` |
| `darkMode` | boolean | `true` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| ol/li honored. Circles render as squares. | Fine. | Text swaps via dm-text where honored. Number badges keep the accent color. |



## Example usage

This is a content-level component: it goes inside a column, so put it in the `content` of a `layout/section` (or another layout).

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('content/numbered-list', {
  "items": [
    "Pick the fit that suits you from our size guide.",
    "Choose your color and add it to the bag.",
    "Try it at home for 60 days, returns are free."
  ]
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "content/numbered-list",
  "data": {
    "items": [
      "Pick the fit that suits you from our size guide.",
      "Choose your color and add it to the bag.",
      "Try it at home for 60 days, returns are free."
    ]
  }
}
```
